dependencies.purpose: Specification authority: normative schema, validation semantics, deterministic rules, conformance reference. Interlock validates against it and never modifies it.
dependencies.devpostDisclosure: Interlock builds on the pre-existing open-source workspace.json specification (workspacejson/standard, Apache-2.0), created before the contest by the same organization. It is consumed as a pinned dependency; no specification source was copied into the submission and no specification change was made for the contest.
boundaryNotes: standard/AGENTS.md forbids proprietary references, including @marcelle-labs/*. The dependency direction is strictly Interlock -> Standard, never the reverse.
standard/AGENTS.md forbids prescriptive policy and producer code in that repository.
Changing Standard requires a separately approved Standard issue; HAC-328 does not authorize one.

dependencies.purpose: Real commit-history co-change mining and the neutral workspace.json producer. Supplies the evidence that drives the Interlock counterfactual for HAC-330/S-1. Executed from the sibling checkout.
dependencies.devpostDisclosure: Co-change evidence is produced by the pre-existing open-source workspace.json CLI and its L0 commit-graph mining core (workspacejson/cli, Apache-2.0), created before the contest by the same organization. Interlock executes it as an external tool at a pinned revision; no mining logic was copied into the submission.
boundaryNotes: @workspacejson/mining-core is private:true and unpublished. It CANNOT be installed from a registry; it must be executed from this pinned sibling checkout or packed locally.

mining-core authorizes mine -> score -> select only. L1 projection onto generated.coChange is explicitly NOT authorized by that package (A-009 staged transition, step 3). Interlock must not emit co-change into a workspace.json artifact on the strength of this package.
HAC-328 forbids speculative CLI changes to rescue the demo. Any CLI change needs its own upstream issue and evidence.
Canonical reproduction driver: evidence/meta-310/meta310-mine.mjs, byte-frozen at sha256 5be5c814caed895b30a26d6fee697e1b65bc01c95789235dc49ad2a3f805e83c (digest verified during HAC-328 bootstrap).

submissionLocalMachinery.purpose: Bounded consumer-local adapter for HAC-330/S-1. Locates the pinned workspacejson/cli sibling checkout, refuses to run unless it matches the manifest pin and is clean, executes the upstream mine -> score -> select pipeline in place, and wraps the verbatim selection in a provenance envelope recording producer SHA, package version, producer bundle digest, source revision, history basis and artifact digest. It adds one check the upstream package does not make: whether the repository that was mined is the repository that was requested.
submissionLocalMachinery.disclosureLanguage: The HAC-330 evidence adapter is a submission-local wrapper authored during the contest. It executes the pre-existing open-source workspace.json mining pipeline at a pinned revision and records provenance around the result; it contains no mining logic of its own, emits no workspace.json artifact, and is NOT part of released WorkspaceJSON v0.4 (@workspacejson/spec 0.4.4). It carries no specification authority.
submissionLocalMachinery.harvestTarget: workspacejson/cli, only via a separately approved upstream issue carrying the repository-attribution finding recorded in experiments/hac-330/README.md
boundaryNotes: Consumes mine -> score -> select only. project() is exported by @workspacejson/mining-core but is deliberately not called: L1 emission onto generated.coChange is step 3 of the A-009 staged transition, which that package does not authorize.
No workspace.json is written by this experiment, and no coChange key appears in any committed evidence artifact.
Upstream was not modified. The experiment refuses to run against a workspacejson/cli checkout that is dirty or off the manifest pin.

submissionLocalMachinery.purpose: Frozen local fixtures, protected mutation broker and evaluation harness for the HAC-330/S-1 concept gate. Generates two deterministic Git histories that differ only in which files were historically co-maintained, drives two individually valid intents through one decision path, and checks each acceptance criterion mechanically against a deterministic target invariant.
submissionLocalMachinery.disclosureLanguage: The HAC-330 fixture harness is submission-local experimental machinery authored during the contest for the S-1 concept gate. It generates synthetic Git histories for a controlled local experiment and is NOT part of released WorkspaceJSON v0.4, nor of any WorkspaceJSON repository. It carries no specification authority.
